synthesis.chief_complaint_evolution: Initial report of sudden severe pain and swelling in the right big toe joint overnight, causing extreme sensitivity to touch (unable to bear a bedsheet touching it).

key_findings_timeline.finding: Sudden severe pain and swelling of the right big toe joint overnight, cannot bear the bedsheet touching it.
